h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ghaziabad

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ghaziabad

items.pText: Ghaziabad has filled with high-rise housing, from Indirapuram and Vaishali to Raj Nagar Extension and Crossings Republik. Most of our enquiries here come from builders who need a play area ready before handover and from residents' associations upgrading one afterwards. FunPlay Systems makes the equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,130 km away, and sends it to the NCR by road.

The two buyers want different things. A builder needs a play area that photographs well, fits the approved site plan and is ready for possession. A residents' association wants equipment that will last, suits the children who actually live there and is easy to maintain. We work with both, and the layout drawing is where those needs get settled before anything is made.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: For builders handing over a project

c: Bring us in when the garden and site plan is being finalised, before the paving is done. We can suggest a play station that matches the project's look, mark foundation points for the civil contractor and plan rubber flooring at the same time. Share the age mix you expect, since a project of family flats needs more junior equipment than one of smaller units. After handover, the residents' association can deal with our after-sales team directly.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,130 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: When should a builder contact you about the playground?
items.a: While the garden and site plan is being finalised. That way foundation points and flooring are planned with the civil work, instead of breaking new paving later.

items.q: Can a residents' association add equipment to an existing play area?
items.a: Yes. Send us photos and measurements of the current area. We will suggest pieces that fit and redraw the layout with safe play areas for the old and new equipment.

items.q: Who do residents contact for after-sales service?
items.a: Our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com. The warranty covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.
